projects.title: Featured Projects

items.title: Interactive Recipe Book with AI
items.description: Smart web application with streaming responses for interactive recipe creation and management.
items.longDescription: Smart Web Application built with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript designed for real-time interactive recipe management, personalization, and creation using artificial intelligence.
responsibilities: Implementation of Vercel AI SDK with streaming responses for real-time interactive culinary assistance.
Structured recipe generation strictly validated using Zod schemas.
Utilization of Server Actions for data persistence and mutations without traditional REST APIs.
Responsive, dynamic, and accessible UI layout built modernly with Tailwind CSS.
items.challenges: Ensuring AI-generated streaming responses maintained a strict, immutable data structure without runtime parsing errors through Zod schema enforcement.

items.title: Smart Financial Management with AI Agent
items.description: Personal finance control, budget management, and multi-account balance tracking with a real-time AI agent.
items.longDescription: Smart Web Application built with Next.js (App Router), React, and TypeScript for personal finance control, budget management, and real-time bank account/credit card tracking.
responsibilities: Built an interactive conversational agent using Vercel AI SDK and Gemini API to parse natural language prompts for recording expenses, income, budgets, and account balances.
Strict parsing and validation of user financial intent via Zod schemas.
Modern backend architecture using Server Actions for atomic mutations and balance/debt updates.
Prisma v7+ modeling on PostgreSQL (Supabase), route revalidation (revalidatePath), and safe Decimal type serialization.
items.challenges: Handling state and mathematical accuracy when atomically updating balances and debts across multiple accounts driven by unstructured natural language input.

items.title: Minimalist Note-Taking App with AI & Neon DB
items.description: Smart note-taking and task management platform featuring rich text editing, auto-categorization, and cloud persistence.
items.longDescription: Modern web application built with Vue 3, Pinia, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Combines a warm paper-inspired UI with AI capabilities to organize notes, check-lists, and thoughts effortlessly with cloud storage.
responsibilities: Architected the application frontend using Vue 3 Composition API, Pinia state management, and Lucide Icons.
Integrated an interactive AI assistant for smart title generation, automatic tag suggestions, text summarization, style refinement, and action item extraction.
Designed a flexible note editor supporting rich text formatting, checklist toggle, undo/redo history stack, and color palette customization.
Configured Neon PostgreSQL database integration for secure cloud persistence and scalable storage.
items.challenges: Delivering a seamless hybrid editor capable of switching dynamically between rich text and interactive checklists while retaining undo/redo state and real-time AI transformations.
